market_question: Will Neymar play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
reasoning: Neymar will be 34 by 2026, with a history of major injuries including a recent ACL tear. Brazil has an abundance of young attacking talent (Vinícius, Rodrygo, Endrick) that could push him out of the squad. His move to Al-Hilal reduced the level of competition, potentially affecting form. While he may still be selected if fit, the cumulative risk of injury and performance decline makes a ~65% chance of playing more realistic than the market's ~80%.
evidence_points: Neymar suffered a torn ACL in October 2023, missing about a year; his durability at 34 is a major concern.
Brazil's emerging forwards (Vinicius Jr., Rodrygo, Endrick) provide strong alternatives, lessening dependence on Neymar.
His club form at Al-Hilal has been inconsistent and low-profile, which may influence call-ups.
sources_consulted: General sports news and injury reports up to early 2025
